question: One diagonal of a rhombus shaped field of area 240 m² is of length 16 m. Then, cost of fencing the field at the rate of ₹ 21 per metre is :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diagonal d₂ = (2 × Area) ÷ d₁ = (2 × 240) ÷ 16 = 30 m.

Half-diagonals are 8 m and 15 m. Using Pythagorean triplet (8, 15, 17), side = 17 m.

Perimeter = 4 × Side = 4 × 17 = 68 m.

Total Cost = 68 × 21 = ₹ 1428.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 1428.**
